artifact.grammar: The phrase "its occupants having long since repaired to the Continent" is an absolute participial construction. It is not a full main clause; it hangs off the first clause and gives background or reason. The form "having + past participle" shows that the occupants' going happened before the house stood in decay. In plain English, it means "because its occupants had gone to mainland Europe long before."
